result.summary: The street features a narrow paved sidewalk on one side and an unpaved, degraded walkway on the other, offering minimal protection for pedestrians. There are no visible crosswalks, lane markings, or traffic calming measures, creating a car-centric environment with poor visibility around parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unpaved walkway
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto uneven dirt or gravel surfaces.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at the approaching intersection, increasing risk during street crossings.

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalk with no buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and directly adjacent to parked cars and moving traffic without any safety buffer.

interventions.title: Pave and widen sidewalks
interventions.description: Ensure continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Install high-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, such as a raised sidewalk or a curb. Pedestrians must navigate a mix of concrete pads and unpaved dirt surfaces that are flush with the roadway, offering no physical protection from vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of vertical separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or raised sidewalk to separate pedestrians from the travel lane, exposing them to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, along the entire street edge

hazards.name: Uneven walking surface
hazards.description: The area intended for walking is a mix of dirt, gravel, and concrete pads, creating significant trip hazards and accessibility barriers.
hazards.location_in_image: Area between the building steps and the asphalt roadway

interventions.title: Install Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, raised concrete sidewalk with a curb to provide physical separation and a level walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and improve the overall quality of the street environment.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, though they lack a buffer from the roadway. The presence of a large institutional building, likely a school, suggests a high potential for pedestrian activity despite the absence of marked crossings or traffic calming features in view.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross and for drivers to see them.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Given the presence of a school building, a marked midblock crossing with signage would improve safety for students and residents.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Adding street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while helping to calm traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk adjacent to a large stone institutional or residential building. Parallel on-street parking is present, providing a partial physical barrier between pedestrians and the roadway, though there is no dedicated planting or furniture buffer.

hazards.name: Lack of buffer
hazards.description: There is no buffer zone (like a planting strip) between the sidewalk and the curb, placing pedestrians close to the roadway.
